en.answer: The effect of <<13013>> that Special Summons a Jurraegg Token can be activated not only when the controller of <<13013>> Normal or Special Summons a Dinosaur-Type monster, but also when their opponent Normal or Special Summons a Dinosaur-Type monster.
en.question: Can I activate the effect of <<13013>> that Special Summons a Jurraegg Token to the opponent's field even when my opponent Normal or Special Summons a Dinosaur-Type monster?
